definition: Paleopallium is an older cortical region of the brain in the basal forebrain and medial temporal lobe that receives input from the olfactory bulb. It is part of the olfactory cortex.

provenance.scope: Source record D066194; pinned source text

reasons: The packet supports that this is a basal forebrain and medial temporal lobe area receiving synaptic inputs from the olfactory bulb, but it does not support the added claim that it is an "older cortical region."
The statement that it "is part of the olfactory cortex" is not stated in the packet text; the source label alone is not enough to support that as a substantive claim.
The definition claims Paleopallium is an “older” cortical region, but the packet does not include the word “older” or any age-related/ancestry sense of the term.

The packet states “Basal forebrain and medial part of temporal lobe areas that receive synaptic inputs from the OLFACTORY BULB,” but does not explicitly phrase this as an “older cortical region,” nor does it explicitly state “part of the olfactory cortex” in the definition text itself (it is only indirectly suggested by the packet’s source label/category).
